Lactic Acid Cycling Saturday Ride

Boise, ID · North End / Bogus Basin Rd · Road

Lactic Acid Cycling Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Boise, ID. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am from LuLu's Pizza.

How we know

Lactic Acid Cycling's Weekly Ride Information page (fetched Oct 1, 2026) lists the Sat Sept 26 rides and a Thu Oct 1 MTB ride, and says the Saturday ride starts at 10:00 am October to April, 9:00 am in May and September, 8:00 am June to August, usually from LuLu's Pizza; the listing carried the September 9:00 time.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 18–22 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Lactic Acid Cycling Saturday Ride group ride

The club's main weekly road ride. A and B groups usually roll from LuLu's Pizza on Bogus Basin Rd, and the start time shifts with the season. Long group goes 65 to 100 miles, short group 34 to 65. Rides and any start changes are announced by club forum email and on the club Facebook group.
